_comment: Tiers map to FAMILY regex patterns, not dated IDs. resolve-models.sh picks the newest live model whose ID matches the pattern; if the API is unreachable (or the key can't see that family) it uses the pinned fallback. Edit patterns/fallbacks freely — this is the single source of truth for routing. FRONTIER targets the Fable family but falls back to Opus, so keys without Fable access still resolve to a working model rather than empty. Fallbacks are illustrative; update to whatever you consider stable.
